notes.title: Final content update
notes.notes: 5 new girls, it's also now moddable. Plenty of quality of life updates. Thanks for the fish. Tired.

notes.title: Love Rocket 0.2.666 Small update with 5 girls, upcoming price hike on release
notes.notes:
Rest of the season 2 girls are here along with a few minor fixes. MG, Tama, Clara, The Ensign and a mystery girl are now available to play and unlock. The last clothing item effect bg and voice reacts have been deprecated.

The price will go up to 6.99 after valentines day upon release and the first batch of the last season releasing.

notes.title: Season 2 release date is 12/18/2024
notes.notes: It will release between 8 and 12 am EET

notes.title: Hotfix for 0.1.666
notes.notes: Fixed aspect ratio issues with wide screens.

notes.title: Fixed Cao Fen update not working
notes.notes: Removed redundant launch option and compatibility build so the game is working now with the new Cao Fen update, if you have need for the compatibility build, please contact the devs via discord and we'll get you working with achievements included.

notes.title: Love Rocket 0.1.3 - Post rank 5 reward image update
notes.notes: Upon completion of a level past rank 5 (undressed + 3 additional targets) yields another reward image, which is, of course, dirtier! Images have been added for all 5 characters.

notes.title: Quality of life update
notes.notes:
- Cheshire’s dialogue reworked
- You can now replay past levels
- Right clicking skips dialogue
- Tooltips fixed
- Ships no longer shoot missiles off screen
- Missiles no longer scatter too low
- Cheshire health lowered in some parts
- Julia dialogue fixed
- Scratch ticket no longer shows last result
